notes.title: Ver. 1.0.2 Patch
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42353226/d906226131390f54c26b917f9e4a87964271b24f.jpg
Hello.
This is Himitsu CP, Incubus production company.

First of all, thank you for waiting for the patch.
Below is information about 1.0.2 Patch.

1. Add SD H Place
SD H, which was previously available only at home, in parks and in cafes, is now available in new places.
There are three new places, a movie theater, a mart, and a library.
Please enjoy the new experience in the added place.

2. Add NTR Branch
The NTR genre has people's likes and dislikes.
For those who want to see NTR stories, we added the ability to view NTR stories through selection.
If you enjoy NTR, please enjoy the new story through your choice.

3. Change the title scene image
We changed the title image to a new style for summer.

4. Additional UI improvements
A UI for the following story objectives has been added to the Heroine UI.
We have increased user convenience by providing clearer goals.

5. Fixed achivement error
Fixed errors that existed in some achievements.
I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

6. Improved translation of Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese 
I apologize to many Chinese users first.
I caused you a lot of inconvenience due to poor translation.
This translation is not perfect, but I tried to improve it compared to before.
We will continue to make efforts to improve translation.

Thank you to the many users who enjoy Incubus.

We will return to the 1.0.3 patch as soon as possible, with new systems added.

First, we rolled back the game to the first system before the previous update.
As it is a system that many users have loved, we are preparing scenes and updates according to the current version.

2. Add scenario skip function

Added scenario skip functionality.
If you press Esc, the scenario can be skipped.
In some scenarios, availability may be limited.

3. Remove the 30-day time limit

I removed the play ending that many people were uncomfortable with.
Now you can play comfortably even after the 30th.

4. Add master file to save slot 6

Added master save data for use before the next update.
I'm sorry that I couldn't save the data that was lost due to the version change.
First, please enjoy the scenes through the master file.

Thank you for always being interested in our game and giving us your opinions.
I will do my best to improve the completeness of the game. Thank you.

notes.title: Announcement about game release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42353226/d906226131390f54c26b917f9e4a87964271b24f.jpg

First of all, I apologize for the delay in the release of this game.

There are two reasons for the delay in game release.

1. Game translation problem

For this translation, I met with various outsourcing companies and had a meeting.
As a result, the contract was signed with the most talented company.
We are currently working hard through all the personnel.

But the biggest problem is the amount of translation. 
Existing and newly added scenarios, which are completely different from the previous ones, are significantly increasing in volume and taking longer than expected.
Currently, there are 27 types of H scenes in the newly updated game, and a total of 7 heroin appear.

These issues also change the language included at launch.
The languages provided through this update are English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.

Japanese language will be updated in March.

Currently, the translation progress is about 90%.

It's inevitably getting late because I'm working to provide a more complete experience.
However, I apologize again for the confusion caused by the repeated revision after the announcement.

2. Improved gameplay

It is a completely different game from the existing game that is currently being updated.
You can be confident that the game is 300,000% better than before.
However, there are loopholes that continue to be found as they try to completely change the direction of the play for a short period of time.

I want to show all of these things at once.This keeps delaying the update.

Above all, this update is a very meaningful event for our company.
Existing fans love our company even more.
It's a chance for new fans to fall in love with our game.

Perhaps all users will definitely be able to experience something new through improved games.
We are also planning a full launch, not early access, with this update.

Perhaps this update will be made before February 20th.

I apologize again for the confusion caused by the continuous update.
Thanks to the fans who have been waiting for us, we were able to cheer up and come this far.
I will do my best to meet your expectations.
Thank you always and I love you. Guys.

- Incubus Production Company HimiutsuCP -
